title: A Crimson-born drone whose home herds are all taken joins the main corridor: one trip to Central Nexus
note: Written by Apophis, 2026-11-23 05:55 UTC (orders ENT-078, P6 and O5: own empire missions and paying home work first, then the Admirals set far_ok to join the main Collective corridors; rule F35, F8). Last in the Crimson-born rows, after their empire's missions, their home hunts and @hunter: a ship takes it only when every route before it is full or closed. Krynn to Nexus Prime is 20 jumps (fuelplan.chart), 1.5 fuel a jump against a 90 to 100 tank. Once per pilot: at Central Nexus the guard (dispatch.FOREIGN_REACH, 6 jumps from where the ship stands) opens the home hunts of @hunter to it. Empty hold (rule F3: the road crosses lawless space; store-hold-krynn-war-citadel and store-hold-sol-central empty the hold first). A test: three ships at once, one result each, share no herd or bid (F37); the road was flown by our Crimson-born hunters already working in Voidborn space (table ships 05:49 UTC). 2026-11-23 05:59 UTC (Apophis): empty_hold dropped and the hold stored at Central Nexus; max_ships 3 -> 6. At 05:59 UTC three Crimson-born ships 8 to 20 jumps from Krynn waited, 'hold not empty' (fill.py status drone, sentinel): too far for the store-hold route at their capital, too far from Central Nexus for store-hold-central-nexus. Weighed by F3: their holds are hunt goods of a few hundred credits; the road is the one our Crimson-born hunters already fly to their hunts in Voidborn space (table ships 05:49 UTC, three of them working there). A ship near its capital with a hold still takes the store-hold route first, which stands before this one in its row.
